name: peter-claude-plugins
description: Personal plugins for Claude Code / Claude Desktop Cowork

plugins.name: idea-capture
plugins.description: 跨專案的 idea 快速記錄工具

plugins.name: capture-test
plugins.description: 通用測試情境建構工具 — 引導式訪談 + 驗證積木 + 測試日誌 + 整併優化

plugins.name: skill-hygiene
plugins.description: Skill 維護工具 — gotchas 累積 + usage tracking + 使用量報告

plugins.name: autofill
plugins.description: 加密個資自動填表 — 安全地自動填寫 Web/PDF/Excel/Word 表單，個人資料永遠不經過 Claude API

plugins.name: modularize
plugins.description: 分析既有專案的模組化程度，產出重構建議報告，降低耦合提升協作效率

plugins.name: scope-guard
plugins.description: 開發過程中的 scope guardian — 防止 scope creep，補齊規格缺口，管理 TODO 優先級

plugins.name: justin-giveaway
plugins.description: JUSTIN投資日記 weekly giveaway 自動化 — YouTube 留言 + X 分享 + Google Form 截圖上傳，可排程

plugins.name: session-comms
plugins.description: 多 session 溝通協議 — 讓平行開發的 Claude Code sessions（git worktree）透過 file-based inbox 非同步交換訊息

plugins.name: zeabur-watch-deploy
plugins.description: Poll the latest Zeabur deployment after a git push and extract build log error snippets on failure. Pure bash + GraphQL, no MCP subprocess.

plugins.name: insforge
plugins.description: InsForge development skills — SDK usage, backend CLI (tables / migrations / functions / storage), debugging, and third-party integrations (auth + payment). Enable per-project via <project>/.claude/settings.json.

plugins.name: pre-commit-pipeline
plugins.description: Commit/ship 守門員 — hook 機制強制驗證 /simplify、/review、/verify-tests、/document-release、/tidy-docs 跑過才放行，含 verify-tests skill
